name: DPP Buyer (UNTP)
description: Verifies a manufacturer's UNTP Digital Product Passport and its Make records, and requests its Digital Conformity Credential. On the UNTP trust framework, anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor.
summary: DPP Buyer wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the UNTP trust framework (role member): the issuers and verifier of noop/dpp_buyer, but every DID it verifies must be anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor chained to a registrar it trusts, and it onboards with a DIA from a registrar (untp/registrar) before others can verify what it signs. It verifies the manufacturer's passport and Make records and requires a DIA of every issuer it verifies.
